history.summary: POSSIBLE DUPLICATE of seq 738 ("ISKCON Temple Dimapur", id iskcon-temple-dimapur) - same real temple; unique id used here. UNVERIFIED: all substantive details come from a single AI-generated, uncited source (inheritage.foundation), and its own page contradicts itself - "consecrated 1995 CE" in one section vs "completed 2012" in the conservation section. The temple is stated to be at Signal Bosti, Dimapur (Dimapur district, Nagaland 797112), dedicated to Lord Krishna; radha consort is presumed from ISKCON convention (unverified). No official ISKCON centre listing for Dimapur was found. Coordinates are geocoded to the Signal Bosti locality only, approximate. No reliable image of the actual temple was found.

name: ISKCON Temple, Dimapur
town_description: Dimapur is Nagaland's largest city and its commercial hub, and the main gateway into the state. It sits at the foothills of the Naga Hills in Dimapur district and is home to the state's only civil airport and a key railway station. Signal Bosti is a residential locality in Dimapur town.
